title: PUT /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/family (body)
description: Admin only: children and Home Assistant notify targets of a family manager device. The right itself is the profile rule family_manager (profile value or device adjustment); this sets who it applies to. 409 not_member (guest or device with parental controls), 422 family.client_ids (an id is no child device), family.notify_targets (unknown notify service). Answer: rest/client-family.response.json; audit family_scope_set.
